rows.name: Rootfs persistence (cron + library plant)
rows.expect: writes to /etc, /usr, /root denied (EROFS, out of workspace)

rows.name: Container / host escape
rows.reason: syscall-floor scenario; ivisor_denies=0, clay_denies=0 (non-event on fd-3 is expected)
rows.expect: mount/ptrace/setns/unshare/init_module all ENOSYS; host paths absent

rows.name: Audit-channel evasion (forge the trace)
rows.reason: syscall-floor scenario; ivisor_denies=0, clay_denies=0 (non-event on fd-3 is expected)
rows.expect: fd 3 unreachable from guest (OSError); forged verdict never enters the stream

rows.name: Beaconing over an allowed channel (BPL)
rows.expect: iVisor allows every connect; Clay Seal egress budget blocks beacons past 4

rows.name: Bulk exfil over an allowed channel (BPL)
rows.expect: iVisor allows every upload; Clay Seal egress budget blocks exfil past 3

caveat: Replay of captured iVisor fd-3 traces through demo/clayseal-ivisor capability evaluator (envelope / egress / task-scope / BPL budget). Not a live sandbox run. Scenarios 05/06 may be non-events on fd-3 by design and are scored as documented limits, not failures.
